## Overview

LRPDID101 is the **independent-prior intercept sensitivity companion** to
[LRPDID01](../lrp-rli-did-001/). It is the same arm-by-wave model, the same data and the
same sampler settings, differing in exactly one thing: the intercept prior.

| | LRPDID01 (reference) | LRPDID101 (this model) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| intercept $\alpha$ | pooled observed t1 logit anchor $+$ zero-centred offset (empirical Bayes) | free $\alpha \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\ 1.5)$, no outcome-informed location |
| randomised t2 contrast $\tau_{t2}$, all other terms | tier scale | tier scale — unchanged |
| everything else | — | identical |

## Why this model exists

The arm-by-wave models centre their intercept prior on the pooled observed t1 logit —
an **empirical-Bayes anchor**: the same t1 observations then enter the fitted
likelihood (#390 P1). The 2026-07-24 methodological ruling retained the anchor with
three conditions; the explicit label and the stated prior-predictive limitation landed
with #481. This fit is the remaining condition: a sensitivity fit whose intercept
prior is *genuinely independent* of the outcomes — not a wider scale around the same
anchor, whose mean would remain data-dependent, but the ordinary free zero-centred
intercept the dose variants already use.

Because this fit's intercept was **not** told where the data are, its prior-predictive
check is a genuine location check — exactly the diagnostic strength the anchored fits
give up, per the limitation note their reports carry.

## How to read the comparison

The two fits may be compared only when both current reporting traces pass the complete
automatic gate. The anchor moves the *level*; $\tau_{t2}$ is a within-t2 arm contrast
a full wave away from the t1 anchor. If the anchor does no inferential work beyond
locating the intercept, $\tau_{t2}$ (and the other arm gaps) should match LRPDID01 to
within Monte-Carlo error. A material shift would mean the anchor is leaking into the
randomised contrast, and the family's intercept policy would need revisiting.

_Sign convention and reading rules as LRPDID01:_ positive favours the intervention;
$\tau_{t2}$ is the clean randomised t2 contrast, `arm_gap_t1` a baseline-balance
quantity, `arm_gap_t3` the randomised early-start-versus-delayed-start schedule
contrast, and `delta_crossover` the change between the two randomised regime
contrasts, neither of them mechanism-identified.
